verdict.rationale: All evidence describes PagerDuty exposing an official MCP server (docs-1, docs-14, docs-34, docs-54, probe-2) so external AI clients can call PagerDuty's tools, and its SRE/Scribe/Shift agents use specific proprietary connectors (GitHub, Sentry) — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether a user can plug arbitrary MCP servers INTO PagerDuty so its agents can consume their tools. No evidence shows PagerDuty acting as an MCP client or accepting third-party MCP servers.
